question: Complete the series: **24,120, 720, 5040, 40320, ____**?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7669f78af03fc26d08e3111e57e67f52af5992368f283790e03d979ffd57c7f6.png] 

Here, 24 = 4! = 4 × 3 × 2 × 1

120 = 5! = 5 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 1

720 = 6!

5040 = 7!

40320 = 8!

thus, **"362880"** will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".
